input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At “正在路上走,” add a little setting detail to make the journey easier to picture: “山路两边长满了各种各样的植物。”
2. After “生病了,” show what being ill looks like: “他们有的捂着肚子，有的脸色发白。”
3. After 神农 decides to help, add his inner thought: “神农心想：我一定要弄清楚哪些植物能吃。”

ideas.reason: This concrete setting detail fits Shen Nong seeing many plants on the road.
This gives clear, simple signs of illness that fit the scene.
The learner already says that Shen Nong wants to know which plants can and cannot be eaten.
